prompt: A single continuous painted animated shot. The silver-haired restaurant owner in an olive shirt finishes using the tablet. His left fingertip lifts away from the glass toward himself. He bends that elbow and draws his whole left hand back toward his torso, clearly away from the tablet, then sets the hand on the wooden bench beside the flat receipts. His fingers relax together naturally. He looks down at the receipts with a small thoughtful nod. The tablet stands completely still. Keep the same face, proportions, warm painterly texture, kitchen, lighting and framing. The camera is fixed on a tripod with no zoom or movement. Calm, unhurried human movement.
